scenes.text: Imagine standing in a gorgeous 50-mile strip of Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically get away with absolutely any crime, even murder.
This is not some crazy movie plot, but a real, terrifying constitutional loophole known as the Zone of Death, which exists because this uninhabited land falls into a bizarre jurisdictional overlap.

The Sixth Amendment strictly guarantees you a trial by a jury from the exact state and district where the crime occurred, but since zero people live in this specific area, a legal jury cannot physically be formed.
The government has known about this dangerous legal loophole for over twenty years and still hasn't fixed it, so would you ever dare to camp here? Hit follow for more mind-blowing secrets.
